1: It came to pass that the disciples sat together in a circle, and Jesus sat in their midst. And He said: I am come forth out of the Light that is in the Light, and I am come down into the world to save the world. Blessed are you that you have known Me; for many desire to see what you see, and have not seen it.
[Pistis Sophia I 7 — The fall of the light]

And Sophia, the last of the emanations, looked up to the Light and desired it beyond measure; and she went forth out of her own region, and was drawn down by the powers of chaos, and her light was taken from her. And she cried out in her oppression, and her cry ascended to the Light of lights.

And Sophia repented, and said: Light of lights, in whom I have had faith, save me. How many times have I cried and Thou hast not heard? Yet still I trust, for I have no other refuge, and Thy light is the only thing my eyes remember.
2: [Pistis Sophia II 65 — The mystery of repentance]

Jesus said: Whosoever shall find the mystery of the repentance of Sophia, that mystery is higher than all the heavens, and higher than all the aeons; for by it the fallen are lifted, and by it the lost are found, and by it the whole of chaos is turned into glory.

Do not seek the Light in the height alone, nor in the depth alone; for a spark of it is hidden in every soul, and that spark cries out as Sophia cried, and that cry is heard. He who quenches it in another quenches it in himself.
[Pistis Sophia II 79 — The ransom of the soul]

And the soul that has been in the chaos comes forth at last, and it is washed, and it is clothed in a garment of light, and it forgets the affliction as a woman forgets her travail when she has brought forth the child.
3: And Sophia offered up thirteen repentances, one for each of the aeons of her fall, and at the thirteenth the veil of the Light was drawn back, and she saw the True Light, and she said: I am now become a citizen of the Light, and my affliction is turned to knowledge.
[Pistis Sophia III 126 — The teaching of mercy]

And Jesus said to His disciples: Be merciful as the Light is merciful, for the Light withholds nothing from the worthy or the unworthy, but shines upon the chaos until the chaos itself gives back light.
[Pistis Sophia IV 136 — The end of seeking]

And the disciples said: Lord, who then can be saved? And He answered: He who seeks shall find, and he who finds shall be troubled, and he who is troubled shall reign, and he who reigns shall rest. And they understood that the whole gospel was in these four doors.
